attributes.action: Make sanitary pads free for those with gynaecological conditions
attributes.background: I want the government to act upon this by making an exception card for those with gynaecological conditions eg. womb cancer, endometriosis etc. Endometriosis causes menstrual cycles to be extended like 14 days this causes pads to be bought on a regular basis I want women to feel supported.

rejection.details:
We think this petition is very similar to yours, and you may wish to sign it: 

Fund sanitary products for women with endometriosis, PCOS or adenomyosis on NHS
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/768065
